title: Add rate limiting to admin HTTP endpoint
description:
Add a per-IP rate limiter to the admin HTTP endpoint: configurable requests/minute (default 60). Excess requests → 429 with Retry-After header. Prevents DoS against the admin port. Artifact: admin middleware in both transit and reader.

Acceptance: rate limit enforced per IP; 429 returned with Retry-After; Prometheus /metrics exempt from rate limiting (it's polled frequently); unit test: exceed rate, verify 429
